mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 4.5% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a monetary policy response to high inflation, which typically leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS have increased by more than 0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply contraction regime (as indicated by INDPRO falling below 100), manufacturing output slows, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has increased over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below $750 billion over a 3-month period signals weak consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue growth and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS < 750000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (as indicated by PAYEMS exceeding 200,000 monthly additions), wage growth accelerates, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 200000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
